newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich consolidates Europe investment. [CORRECTED 17:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Zurich consolidates Europe investment. [CORRECTED 17:40 GMT]

text.p: Zurich Insurance Group said on Thursday it was consolidating its investment management activities in Europe into one business unit.
The move will lead to integrating investments under Zurich Investment Management (Europe).

"The first step is to integrate the investments of Zurich Investment Management (UK), Zurich Investment Management (Switzerland) and the securities department at Home Office," Zurich said in a statement.
Zurich Investment Management (Europe) has about $30 billion in assets under management, it added.
(Corrects to clarify that assets under management are those of the business unit, and not the entire group.)
Dominique Morax, previously responsible for asset management at Home Office, was named chief executive and chief investment officer of Zurich Investment Management (Europe), Zurich said.

Gordon Johns and Dennis Ferro, who were previoulsy responsible for management of fixed income and equities, respectively, for Zurich Investment Management (UK), will take the positions of head of fixed income and head of equities, respectively, for Zurich Investment Management (Europe).
